title: Scalar-extension adjunction with normalized underlying Hom bijection
statement: For a ringed-topos morphism f, an algebraic inverse-image lift I, a structural scalar map c with the specified underlying geometric ring map, and a pullback L realized objectwise and on maps by scalar extension after I.modules, the canonical ordinary tensor comparison determines scalar insertion. There is an adjunction L ⊣ f.modules whose underlying-sheaf Hom bijection is exactly the geometric Hom bijection applied after that insertion. This holds for the supplied, rather than an arbitrarily chosen, module direct image. Ringed-topos morphisms and algebraic inverse images are those of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism, def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image]; the canonical comparison is the one of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation].

proof.text: The module-linearity condition constructs inverse transposes using the geometric adjunction. The generalized scalar-action relation proves both transposes are linear. Their underlying maps are inverse and natural.

Compose with the tensor-extension adjunction; its insertion formula gives the normalized underlying Hom bijection. Transport along the given object equalities to L. The canonical comparison inserts one on every generalized section, so its insertion agrees with the tensor unit.

theorem suppliedTensorAdjunction_normalized
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {A : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} {B : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u}}
    (f : RingedToposMorphism (RingedTensor.ringSheaf A) (RingedTensor.ringSheaf B))
    (RI : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (I : AlgebraicInverseImage f.inverse B RI)
    (c : RI ⟶ A)
    (hc : (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u})).map c =
      I.ringUnderlying.inv ≫ f.ringMap)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (RingedTensor.ringSheaf B) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (RingedTensor.ringSheaf A))
    (hobj : ∀ M, L.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), L.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
      changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    (k : CanonicalRingedTensorComparison B A RI f.inverse I c L hobj) :
    ∃ am : L ⊣ f.modules,
      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (RingedTensor.ringSheaf B))
        (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (RingedTensor.ringSheaf A)) (v : L.obj M ⟶ H),
        (RingedTensor.underlying B).map (am.homEquiv M H v) ≫ f.underlying.hom.app H =
          f.adj.homEquiv _ _ (I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫ k.q M ≫
            (RingedTensor.underlying A).map v)
